title: PackDescriptor
description: Client-facing descriptor of one runnable pack graph variant — the item shape of the pack-listing API (GET /v1/packs). A read-only VIEW: nodes[] and inputs are derived from packs/<pack>/graphs/<variant>.toml + packs/<pack>/inputs.toml via the fail-closed loader (gtm_core/packs/loader.py); title, description, and min_entitlement are API-layer annotations (optional TOML keys added alongside the pack API — absent on packs that never declare them); available and locked_reason are SERVER-COMPUTED per requesting workspace, so a client never needs to know the entitlement-tier ordering. The descriptor deliberately excludes server-internal fields (prompt text, model_role) so the API never leaks orchestration detail, and carries no destination/egress vocabulary — the same unrepresentable-destination property the pack format itself has. RUN LAUNCH: v1 ask-setting values are STRINGS; a pack-mode run submits inputs as a flat string map {"<key>": "<value>"}. Additive optional form fields (label, help, default, value_type, choices) are reserved on the settings entry so richer forms can arrive without a breaking change. Clients MUST ignore unknown fields and tolerate unknown enum values (additive evolution).

variant.description: Graph variant within the pack, e.g. 'linkedin-post'.

title.description: Optional human display title; clients fall back to '<pack>/<variant>'.

description.description: Optional one-paragraph summary of what a run of this variant produces.

min_entitlement.description: The variant's effective minimum entitlement tier ('free' | 'pro' | 'pro_plus'), server-computed from gtm_core/gating.toml — the max commercial floor of its own node skill tiers, raised by any matching pack-level pricing override. Always present ('free' included) rather than absent-means-unlimited. Enforcement is server-side; clients should prefer the computed 'available'/'locked_reason' fields over interpreting this value.

available.description: Server-computed for the requesting workspace: true when this variant can be launched right now (entitlement satisfied). Clients gate the launch button on this, never on tier comparison.

locked_reason.description: Server-computed, present when available = false — a machine code, e.g. 'entitlement_required'. Open-world.

readiness.description: OPTIONAL, server-computed against the requesting workspace's profile (additive — absent until the readiness surface lands). Two-class provisioning verdict for this variant: 'blocked' = a required input is missing and pack-mode run creation will 422 {"code":"pack_not_ready"}; 'degraded' = stale-but-present (runs proceed; clients may warn); 'ready' = go. In the LISTING, items[] carries only non-ready items (compact); the detail endpoint GET /v1/packs/{pack}/{variant}/readiness returns every item — the onboarding wizard's checklist feed. Reasons are human sentences and never contain server filesystem paths.

status.description: Worst item status. Open-world — treat unknown values as opaque.

kind.description: Which input class the item belongs to. Open-world.

name.description: Settings key or knowledge topic (matches inputs.settings[].key / inputs.knowledge[].topic).

reason.description: Optional human-readable sentence; never an absolute path.

nodes.description: The graph's nodes in declaration order. Ids here are the node_id vocabulary used by run-event 'node' events and snapshot nodes[], so a client can join live progress onto the rendered DAG.

id.description: Node id, unique within the variant.

depends_on.description: Ids of nodes this one depends on. Empty = root node (a variant may have several roots — a fan-out batch).

skill.description: Skill slug the node runs, when skill-backed.

gate.description: True when the node pauses for human approval before the run proceeds.

external_effect.description: Declared external side effect, if any. Loader rule: a GATED node may carry no external effect outside the closed set {'publish', 'email_enroll', 'dnc_add'} (gtm_core.packs.loader._ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_EFFECTS); each value pairs with its own Python-only dispatcher and its own tool-level denial. The pack API additionally rejects, at load, any external_effect on a NON-gated node — so through this API, a node with an external effect is always gated, and gate=false nodes are side-effect-free by construction.

inputs.description: The variant's information requirements (the pack's two-class inputs). 'settings' resolve against the profile's settings; 'knowledge' against the profile's knowledge corpus. Clients build run-launch forms from settings with source='ask'; knowledge entries are readiness signals (present/missing/stale), not form fields.

key.description: Profile settings key, e.g. 'brand_name'. Doubles as the run-inputs map key.

source.description: 'ask' = collected from the operator (a form field); 'derive' = computed server-side.

value_type.description: Reserved (additive): value type hint; absent = string (the v1 assumption).

choices.description: Reserved (additive): enumerated choices for a select field.

freshness.description: How stale this topic may be before a run should re-verify it. Current values: 'evergreen' | '90d'. Open-world — treat unknown values as opaque.

max_bytes.description: Per-item byte cap; absent = global default.
